quarterly_data.quarter: Biren Technology HKEX announcement: Profit Alert (08-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Profit alert (preliminary, unaudited): for H1 2026 the company expects revenue of approximately RMB1,150.0 million to RMB1,300.0 million (vs approximately RMB58.9 million in H1 2025), loss for the period of approximately RMB400.0 million to RMB320.0 million (vs RMB1,600.5 million) and adjusted loss (non-IFRS) of approximately RMB360.0 million to RMB290.0 million (vs RMB551.6 million). The company attributes the growth to strong demand for GPGPU intelligent computing solutions from AI coding, long-horizon AI Agent tasks and generative AI, expanding Bili series sales with scaled deployment and a more diversified customer base, and a low H1 2025 base because deliveries of high-end products were concentrated in the second half of 2025; it cites an improved product mix lifting gross margin and no redemption-liability charges after the January 2, 2026 listing.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue expected approximately RMB1,150.0 million to RMB1,300.0 million
